content.thinking: IPv6Network((addr, plen)) with strict=True default raises on host bits. Use `ipaddress.IPv6Network((addr, plen), strict=False)` which zeroes them.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tests && sed -i 's/ipaddress.IPv6Network((addr, rng.choice(\[32, 48, 56, 64, 96\])))/ipaddress.IPv6Network((addr, rng.choice([32, 48, 56, 64, 96])), strict=False)/' gen.py
cd /workspace && python3 tests/run_tests.py 30 1
